audit_items.proof_trace: Every admin action queries `is_admin` from the DB server-side via `supabase.auth.getUser()` (cookie-backed JWT, server-validated) before mutating data — either through the shared `checkAdmin()` helper or inline checks in `toggleAdminStatus`, `deleteMember`, `updateMemberTeams`, and the `/api/admin/oauth/clients` route handlers. The middleware's `/api` public-path exemption does not introduce a bypass because each API route handler independently enforces 401/403 checks. No action relies on UI-supplied authorization state.
